title: Arn
storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: A boy of the second Far Clan, abducted by Nohrish raiders, who later allies the Far Clans and becomes Keeper of the new Clan Tree.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: The new Keeper of Inys Haen who heals Arn's shoulder and chooses peace over vengeance.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: The Felonarch who attacked Arn in a spell of madness and was later healed of his family's curse.

entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: A hunter who escapes Inys Nohr.

entities.name: Lorris
entities.description: Nohrish warrior, daughter of the executed captain RoNal.

entities.name: RoNal
entities.description: Disgraced and executed captain who showed Arn kindness.

entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: An elf who carries Aylith away and later rescues Arn.

entities.name: Morkin
entities.description: An Albion who secretly undermines efforts to bring light to the world and misleads Arn.

entities.name: Far Clans
entities.description: Scattered, independent clans who resisted the Felonarch and march on Inys Haen.

entities.name: Third Clan
entities.description: A Far Clan where Arn's mission nearly fails.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Nohrish stronghold where Arn served as the Felonarch's page.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Place whose ruins Nazir's forces occupy and where Arn settles.

entities.name: River Sobus
entities.description: Waterway formed by the Parting, used to flee Inys Nohr.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: Land where spring returns after the Mending.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: Tree mended by the spring ritual; the new Clan Tree needs a new Keeper.

entities.name: The Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: Ritual event recited by the Keeper and former Felonarch that brings spring.

events.summary: Arn is captured in a raid and taken to Inys Nohr as the Felonarch's page; Nazir injures his shoulder.
events.quote: He was captured in the spring raid around 3561 AR and taken to Inys Nohr to serve as the Felonarch's page.

events.summary: Aylith heals Arn's shoulder; Arn helps Jedhian and Lorris escape by boat down the River Sobus.
events.quote: the three fugitives stole a boat and fled down the River Sobus

events.summary: Arn resolves to seek an alliance with the Far Clans and pleads for their aid.
events.quote: He resolved to seek an alliance with the Far clans

events.summary: Morkin misleads Arn into an icy marsh; Feryar rescues him, and he succeeds in allying the clans.
events.quote: Arn was rescued at the last moment by Feryar, who guided him back to safety.

events.summary: The Far Clans attack Nazir's forces at Inys Haen; Aylith ambushes the Felonarch and heals him of his family's curse instead of killing him.
events.quote: she chose to pursue peace over vengeance, healing him of his family's curse.

events.summary: Aylith and the former Felonarch recite the spring ritual, mending the Clan Tree.
events.quote: who together recited the spring ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree

events.summary: Arn becomes Keeper of the new Clan Tree and settles in Inys Haen.
events.quote: Arn took the mantle of the Keeper upon himself.

relations.note: as page, pretending to be subservient
relations.quote: though he pretended to be weak and subservient
the new Keeper healed Arn's shoulder
daughter of the disgraced and executed captain RoNal
Arn was rescued at the last moment by Feryar
